### Annual Report 2025

B. Braun continued its long-term growth path in fiscal year 2025. Group sales increase by 5.1
percent at constant currencies to € 9.4 billion.

][159]
[
[nurse talking with patient at the bedsite]

### More time for patient care.

Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

][160]
[
[A healthcare professional is shown standing proudly with a sustainable-produced medical container.]

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in
hospital processes. Digitally enhanced solutions to achieve clinical excellence.

][161]
[
[A medical laboratory employee is pouring liquid for a quality check.]

### Sustainability from the depths

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

][162]
[
[Digital microscope for neurosurgery named Aesculap Aeos® in front of a white background]

### A precise view of the future: New digital microscope technology for neurosurgery

New technology allows high-resolution views into the human body, making it a prerequisite for more
precise surgery.

][163]

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

## Sign up and be the first to know about our exciting innovations.

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

[ Learn more ][229]

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Who we are

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

As PhD students, we found it difficult to access the research we needed, so we decided to create a new Open Access publisher that levels the playing field for scientists across the world. How? By making research easy to access, and puts the academic needs of the researchers before the business interests of publishers. # Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

## Mount Bonnell Gallery

Check out our gallery page with beautiful photos of Mount Bonn that other visitors have shared. Why
not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

[Fix Appointment][113]

**Orthopedic Implants & Instruments**: Quality and trust are two major factors that orthopedic
surgeons consider when selecting orthopedic implants. Orthopedic experts worldwide not only trust
NET Orthopedic Implants but also confidently recommend them to their peers due to their high
quality. Narang Medical Limited operates its own state-of-the-art factory dedicated to manufacturing
Orthopedic Implants and Instruments. This factory is one of the largest in India, equipped with
skilled production staff of approximately 250 people. As a leading manufacturer and supplier of
orthopedic implants, we have established ourselves as a top orthopedic company. Narang Medical Ltd.
is based in India.

Narang Medical is a leading orthopedic implant company that develops a wide range of orthopedic
implant technologies to assist orthopedic medical professionals worldwide. Nearly 100% of our
orthopedic implants are shipped to over 80 countries, making us one of the **world's top orthopedic
implant companies**. Our company operates under a quality system that adheres to **ISO 9001:2015,
ISO 13485:2016, CE, and WHO: GMP Compliance**. Narang Medical Limited currently **supplies
orthopedic implants** in titanium and stainless steel, and many reputable companies in Europe and
the USA regularly purchase orthopedic implants from us. As a leading **manufacturer** and supplier
of an extensive range of orthopedic implants and instruments, we are recognized as one of the top
orthopedic implant companies, not only in India but also globally.

**Why should you source from us?**

We are a renowned manufacturer and supplier of a diverse range of medical and surgical products,
including orthopedic implants. With our expertise and dedication to quality, we have established
ourselves as a trusted name in the field of orthopedic implant manufacturing.

Orthopedic implants play a crucial role in the treatment of various musculoskeletal conditions and
injuries. These implants are designed to provide stability, support, and alignment to the affected
bones and joints, facilitating the healing process and restoring mobility for patients.

As one of the leading **orthopedic implant manufacturers**, we offer a comprehensive portfolio of
implants catering to different orthopedic needs. Our product range includes implants for joint
replacement surgeries, such as hip implants, knee implants, and shoulder implants. These implants
are engineered with precision to ensure proper fit, durability, and compatibility with the patient's
anatomy.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implant offerings also encompass **trauma implants**, which are used in
the treatment of fractures and other traumatic injuries. These implants, including plates, screws,
and nails, are designed to provide stability and support during the healing process, promoting
optimal recovery.

In addition to our wide range of orthopedic implants, we as a leading manufacturer emphasize on
quality assurance and adheres to stringent manufacturing standards. Our products are manufactured
using high-quality materials, ensuring reliability, strength, and biocompatibility. The company's
commitment to maintaining international quality standards has earned us recognition and trust among
healthcare professionals globally.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implants undergo rigorous testing and quality control measures to ensure
safety and efficacy. The implants are designed in consultation with orthopedic surgeons,
incorporating their expertise and feedback to meet the evolving needs of the medical community.

As a customer-centric organization, Narang Medical strives to provide comprehensive support to
healthcare providers. They offer technical assistance, training, and educational resources to
surgeons and medical staff, facilitating the successful implantation and use of their products.

In conclusion, Narang Medical is a leading manufacturer of orthopedic implants, offering a wide
range of high-quality products for joint replacement surgeries and trauma cases. With their focus on
quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Narang Medical continues to contribute to
advancements in orthopedic care and improve the lives of patients worldwide.

orthopedic implants, we have established ourselves as a top orthopedic company. Narang Medical Ltd.
is based in India.

Narang Medical is a leading orthopedic implant company that develops a wide range of orthopedic
implant technologies to assist orthopedic medical professionals worldwide. Nearly 100% of our
orthopedic implants are shipped to over 80 countries, making us one of the **world's top orthopedic
implant companies**. Our company operates under a quality system that adheres to **ISO 9001:2015,
ISO 13485:2016, CE, and WHO: GMP Compliance**. Narang Medical Limited currently **supplies
orthopedic implants** in titanium and stainless steel, and many reputable companies in Europe and
the USA regularly purchase orthopedic implants from us. As a leading **manufacturer** and supplier
of an extensive range of orthopedic implants and instruments, we are recognized as one of the top
orthopedic implant companies, not only in India but also globally.

**Why should you source from us?**

We are a renowned manufacturer and supplier of a diverse range of medical and surgical products,
including orthopedic implants. With our expertise and dedication to quality, we have established
ourselves as a trusted name in the field of orthopedic implant manufacturing.

Orthopedic implants play a crucial role in the treatment of various musculoskeletal conditions and
injuries. These implants are designed to provide stability, support, and alignment to the affected
bones and joints, facilitating the healing process and restoring mobility for patients.

As one of the leading **orthopedic implant manufacturers**, we offer a comprehensive portfolio of
implants catering to different orthopedic needs. Our product range includes implants for joint
replacement surgeries, such as hip implants, knee implants, and shoulder implants. These implants
are engineered with precision to ensure proper fit, durability, and compatibility with the patient's
anatomy.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implant offerings also encompass **trauma implants**, which are used in
the treatment of fractures and other traumatic injuries. These implants, including plates, screws,
and nails, are designed to provide stability and support during the healing process, promoting
optimal recovery.

In addition to our wide range of orthopedic implants, we as a leading manufacturer emphasize on
quality assurance and adheres to stringent manufacturing standards. Our products are manufactured
using high-quality materials, ensuring reliability, strength, and biocompatibility. The company's
commitment to maintaining international quality standards has earned us recognition and trust among
healthcare professionals globally.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implants undergo rigorous testing and quality control measures to ensure
safety and efficacy. The implants are designed in consultation with orthopedic surgeons,
incorporating their expertise and feedback to meet the evolving needs of the medical community.

As a customer-centric organization, Narang Medical strives to provide comprehensive support to
healthcare providers. They offer technical assistance, training, and educational resources to
surgeons and medical staff, facilitating the successful implantation and use of their products.

In conclusion, Narang Medical is a leading manufacturer of orthopedic implants, offering a wide
range of high-quality products for joint replacement surgeries and trauma cases. With their focus on
quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Narang Medical continues to contribute to
advancements in orthopedic care and improve the lives of patients worldwide.

## About Physiopedia

Physiopedia is the world’s leading online knowledge platform for physiotherapy and rehabilitation
professionals. It brings together evidence-based clinical content, practical resources, and
continuing education to support learning, decision-making, and better patient outcomes. Built and
reviewed by qualified clinicians worldwide, Physiopedia helps students, educators, and practitioners
stay current, confident, and connected in an evolving profession.

### Physiopedia Plus

][42]
[
[Physiopedia AI Assistant]

### Physiopedia
### AI Assistant

PAI your physiotherapy learning companion. Explore concepts, deepen your clinical understanding, and
build knowledge with AI-powered educational support

[Physiopedia AI Robot] ][43]

## About Physiopedia

Physiopedia is the world’s leading online knowledge platform for physiotherapy and rehabilitation
professionals. It brings together evidence-based clinical content, practical resources, and
continuing education to support learning, decision-making, and better patient outcomes. Built and
reviewed by qualified clinicians worldwide, Physiopedia helps students, educators, and practitioners
stay current, confident, and connected in an evolving profession.

[Learn more about Physiopedia][44]

## Contribute to Physiopedia

Join a global community shaping the future of rehabilitation education. Contribute your knowledge,
involve your students, or engage your organisation to help expand access to trusted, evidence-based
physiotherapy resources worldwide.

[
[Volunteers]

### Volunteers

Rehabilitation professionals worldwide can edit Physiopedia. Become an editor or join our volunteer
programme to share your expertise and support global access to rehabilitation knowledge.

][45]
[
[Universities]

### Universities

Universities providing rehabilitation education are invited to involve their students in
contributing content to Physiopedia as part of structured learning and educational projects.

][46]

[Organisations]

### Organisations

to Physiopedia through continuing education and professional development projects.

healthcare markets. Our products are developed in accordance with the European Medical Device

through sustainable partnership models, and advance the future of spinal healthcare through
engineering-driven innovation and vertically integrated manufacturing excellence.

surgeries.

deformity cases, customizable to each customer’s needs.

and orthopedic solutions, backed by over 14 years of industry expertise. Operating in more than 30
countries, we supply precision-engineered spinal implants designed to meet the demands of global
healthcare markets. Our products are developed in accordance with the European Medical Device
Regulation (MDR) and fully comply with international quality, safety, and regulatory standards.

 

Our mission is to empower surgeons with reliable spinal implant technologies, support distributors
through sustainable partnership models, and advance the future of spinal healthcare through
engineering-driven innovation and vertically integrated manufacturing excellence.

Physicians in the licensed Regenexx^{®} network provide non-surgical options for individuals
experiencing pain related to orthopedic issues, including osteoarthritis, joint injuries, spine
pain, overuse conditions, and common sports injuries. Using proprietary, research-based methods and
patented protocol, they prepare and precisely apply injectates to support your body's natural
healing processes.

## Why Regenexx?

## Board-Certified Doctors

All physicians in the licensed Regenexx network are musculoskeletal specialists with expertise in
image-guided injections.
[Find a doctor near you][150]

## Locations Nationwide

Over 100 convenient locations nationwide focused on same-day treatment of orthopedic conditions,
injuries and pain without surgery.
[Find a location near you][151]

## Advanced Biotechnology

Regenexx lab processing routinely achieves 20x concentration of stem cell-containing bone marrow —
far above what non-Regenexx providers achieve.
[Learn about our approach][152]

## Over 21 Years of Results

Our research-based approach is supported by direct feedback from thousands of patients.
[Explore patient results][153]

### Hypertension

### Heart Failure

Manage patient journey with automated, AI driven care pathways for remote monitoring using connected
external devices and/or implanted devices

### **Rhythm Management (CIEDs & Loops)**

Comprehensive cardiac device ecosystem provides effective data capture for standardized reports

### **Ambulatory Cardiac Monitors**

MCOTs, wearable EKGs, Cardiac patch monitoring, and more.

[Get Started][19]

## Revolutionize cardiac care with RhythmScience

### Better data. Simple workflows.

**Rhythm360®** is an integrated platform that creates a unified workspace to review, interpret, and
utilize data from patients and devices for hypertension management, heart failure management, and
rhythm management [CIEDs, MCOTs, EKGs, etc]. Receive actionable data from implantable or external
cardiac devices for patients with hypertension, heart failure, and rhythm disorders.

Access critical cardiology data with simple workflows.

[Learn more][20]
[Platform Screenshot]

### Remote cardiology made simple.

Technical services teams can supplement existing clinical care teams to provide expert patient
engagement services. Trained team members are available to help with alert management, patient
compliance, and health coaching.

Always on even when you're off.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

Manufacturing Process

## From Raw Material to Surgical-Ready Implant

Every Virelox product follows a rigorous, traceable manufacturing workflow designed to meet the
demands of modern orthopedic surgery. Our integrated production chain ensures dimensional accuracy,
material integrity, and sterile packaging at every stage.

[Medical-grade titanium and cobalt-chrome raw materials used in Virelox orthopedic implant
production]

STEP 01

### Raw Materials

Medical-grade titanium alloy (Ti-6Al-4V), cobalt-chrome, and surgical stainless steel are sourced
from certified upstream suppliers and inspected prior to production entry.

[Precision slitting process for orthopedic implant bar stock material preparation]

STEP 02

### Slitting

High-precision slitting machines cut bar stock and sheet materials to exact dimensions, ensuring
consistent blanks for downstream CNC machining operations.

[CNC machining center producing precision orthopedic bone screws and implant components]

STEP 03

### CNC Machining

Multi-axis CNC machining centers produce complex implant geometries with micron-level tolerances,
meeting the anatomical accuracy requirements of joint and spinal implants.

[General machining operations for orthopedic implant components at Virelox factory]

STEP 04

### Machining

Turning, boring, and facing operations refine implant surfaces and critical mating interfaces,
ensuring proper fit and long-term in-vivo performance.

[CNC milling process for orthopedic implant plate and rod components at Virelox]

STEP 05

### Milling

Five-axis CNC milling produces complex contoured surfaces on plates, stems, and cups, achieving the
precise geometry required for orthopedic joint reconstruction.

[Final inspection and sterile packaging of Virelox orthopedic implants before shipment]

STEP 06

### Inspection & Packing

Every finished implant passes multi-dimensional CMM inspection, visual verification, and functional
testing before clean-room packaging and export

Quality Control

## ISO 13485 Full-Process Quality Management

With 65 dedicated QC professionals and a fully equipped inspection laboratory, Virelox applies
rigorous testing at every stage — from incoming raw material through final product release —
ensuring zero-compromise quality for every shipment.
* 🔭
  
  X-Ray Inspection
  
  Non-destructive X-ray analysis detects internal voids, inclusions, or structural anomalies in cast
  and forged implant blanks before machining begins.
* ⚙️
  
  Fatigue Testing
  
  Dynamic fatigue testers simulate millions of physiological load cycles, verifying that implants
  meet or exceed required endurance limits for long-term implantation.
* 🧲
  
  Tensile Strength Testing
  
  Universal tensile testers quantify ultimate tensile strength, yield strength, and elongation of
  implant materials and finished components against ISO standards.
* 📐
  
  CMM Dimensional Measurement
  
  Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM) and two-dimensional measuring instruments verify critical
  dimensions with sub-micron precision across every production batch.
* 💠
  
  Hardness & Bone Screw Performance
  
  Dedicated hardness testers and bone screw performance analyzers confirm material hardness grades
  and verify insertion torque, pullout strength, and torsional resistance.

## Engineering the Future of Orthopedic Implants

Our in-house R&D center — staffed by 120 engineers specializing in biomechanics, materials science,
and medical device design — drives continuous product innovation and delivers over 120 new
orthopedic and spinal implant products annually.

DESIGN & ENGINEERING

### Biomechanical Design & Rapid Prototyping

Virelox's R&D center employs biomechanical simulation systems that model in-vivo stress
distribution, load transfer, and wear patterns before a single prototype is manufactured. This
virtual validation pipeline — combined with our rapid prototyping capabilities — allows new implant
designs to move from concept to clinical-ready prototype in a fraction of the time required by
traditional methods. In 2023 alone, our team launched 120 new products, demonstrating an
industry-leading pace of orthopedic innovation.

OEM

CUSTOMIZATION

### OEM/ODM & Custom Implant Geometry

We offer full OEM/ODM services including private label production and surgeon-specified implant
geometry customization. Our engineering team collaborates directly with distributors and surgical
teams to develop patient-matched or market-specific implant variants that meet regional regulatory
requirements.

[Virelox laboratory performing material science testing and biomechanical analysis for implant R&D]

MATERIALS LAB

### Advanced Materials & Surface Science

Our materials laboratory evaluates corrosion resistance, biocompatibility, fatigue properties, and
osseointegration characteristics of new implant alloys and coatings, ensuring every material
selection decision is backed by rigorous scientific data.

65

QUALITY SCIENCE

### 65 QC Professionals & Full-Process Oversight

Quality is not an afterthought at Virelox — it is integrated into every stage of product
development. Our 65-strong QC team works alongside R&D engineers to establish inspection protocols,
tolerance specifications, and test methods for every new product before production release.

850

SUPPLY CHAIN

### 850 Certified Supply Chain Partners

Innovation requires reliable materials. Our network of 850 certified upstream and downstream supply

specialist consumables that R&D prototyping and full-scale production demand.

Quality Control

## ISO 13485 Full-Process Quality Management

With 65 dedicated QC professionals and a fully equipped inspection laboratory, Virelox applies
rigorous testing at every stage — from incoming raw material through final product release —
ensuring zero-compromise quality for every shipment.
* 🔭
  
  X-Ray Inspection
  
  Non-destructive X-ray analysis detects internal voids, inclusions, or structural anomalies in cast
  and forged implant blanks before machining begins.
* ⚙️
  
  Fatigue Testing
  
  Dynamic fatigue testers simulate millions of physiological load cycles, verifying that implants
  meet or exceed required endurance limits for long-term implantation.
* 🧲
  
  Tensile Strength Testing
  
  Universal tensile testers quantify ultimate tensile strength, yield strength, and elongation of
  implant materials and finished components against ISO standards.
* 📐
  
  CMM Dimensional Measurement
  
  Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM) and two-dimensional measuring instruments verify critical
  dimensions with sub-micron precision across every production batch.
* 💠
  
  Hardness & Bone Screw Performance
  
  Dedicated hardness testers and bone screw performance analyzers confirm material hardness grades
  and verify insertion torque, pullout strength, and torsional resistance.

### Biomechanical Design & Rapid Prototyping

Virelox's R&D center employs biomechanical simulation systems that model in-vivo stress
distribution, load transfer, and wear patterns before a single prototype is manufactured. This
virtual validation pipeline — combined with our rapid prototyping capabilities — allows new implant
designs to move from concept to clinical-ready prototype in a fraction of the time required by
traditional methods. In 2023 alone, our team launched 120 new products, demonstrating an
industry-leading pace of orthopedic innovation.

We offer full OEM/ODM services including private label production and surgeon-specified implant

Our materials laboratory evaluates corrosion resistance, biocompatibility, fatigue properties, and

selection decision is backed by rigorous scientific data.

## Professional Orthopedic Implant Manufacturer & Bone Fusion Specialist

Zynfuse Medical Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional orthopedic medical device manufacturer
specializing in bone fusion and advanced implant systems for surgical innovation. Established in
**2016**, the company has built a strong foundation in orthopedic solutions with **12 years of
industry experience** and **7 years of export experience**, serving global healthcare markets with
consistent quality and reliability.

The company operates a modern manufacturing facility covering approximately **18,600 m²**, equipped
with advanced production and testing equipment. Zynfuse maintains an annual export revenue of around
**$18.5 million**, supported by a highly efficient supply chain network of over **1,200 partners**
worldwide. The organization employs **68 quality inspection specialists** ensuring strict compliance
with international medical standards.

## Industry-Leading Quality Certifications

Every Zynfuse product is developed and manufactured under internationally recognized quality
management frameworks, ensuring full compliance with the regulatory requirements of global
healthcare markets.

🏅
ISO 13485

Medical device quality management system certification — the global benchmark for orthopedic implant
manufacturing processes and documentation control.

🔩
Mechanical Performance Testing

All implants undergo rigorous fatigue testing, tensile load verification, and mechanical performance
analysis to ensure surgical reliability under real-world conditions.

🧬
Biocompatibility Evaluation

Comprehensive biocompatibility testing validates material safety for long-term implantation in the
human body, aligned with ISO 10993 standards.

📐
Dimensional Verification

Precision dimensional inspection using advanced 2D video measuring instruments and spectrometer
analysis ensures every implant meets exact surgical specifications.

Global Presence

Zynfuse serves major global markets including North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and the Middle
East, collaborating with hospitals, distributors, orthopedic clinics, and medical device importers
to deliver consistent supply and technical support.
